info.title: Dartcade API
info.description:
HTTP API of the Dartcade backend, used by the web frontend and the Go bridge.
Authentication endpoints (`/api/auth/*`) are provided by better-auth and documented separately.
Operations tagged `bridge` are called by deployed bridges: keep them backwards compatible.
